records.title: Security Incident Update #2
records.summary: Binance said it allocated more than $6.34B of company funds; approximately $5B in corresponding affected-token assets was already held; about $1.34B remained to be acquired through market/OTC channels; and about $3B had been frozen. It announced an initial post-incident PoR snapshot target within 12 hours and results by November 2. No XRP-specific replacement amount was disclosed.
records.limitations: Aggregate USD value is not token-by-token reconciliation, customer-liability proof, or evidence of executed XRP purchases.

records.publisher: Binance official Proof of Reserves portal
records.title: Latest Proof of Reserves portal inspected after special snapshot target
records.summary: Official portal describes zk-SNARK/Merkle verification and controlled wallet disclosure. The rendered text available in this inspection did not expose a new post-incident audit timestamp, root hash or token-by-token reserve result.
records.methodology: Read-only inspection of the official public portal.
records.limitations: Dynamic page may contain data not exposed in text rendering; absence from this capture does not prove the snapshot was not taken.

records.title: How to verify your account balance on Binance — monthly PoR cadence
records.summary: FAQ states the regular monthly PoR snapshot is taken on the first day of each month at 00:00 UTC and results are released by the seventh. This is distinct from the special post-incident 12-hour snapshot target.
records.limitations: Regular monthly cadence does not establish whether the special post-incident snapshot was executed.

records.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
records.summary: CoinDesk reports Binance 14 appeared in Binance's October 1 PoR address set and held 89,475 ETH and 1.26B USDT. It estimates the 204.5K ETH loss could leave ETH backing near 94% until replacement, and says the next regular reserve snapshot is November 1.
records.methodology: Secondary review of public PoR address set and on-chain flows.
records.limitations: This concerns Binance 14 and ETH/USDT; it does not establish membership of the five XRPL XRP source wallets.

records.title: Ripple and Coinbase Partner to Expand Access to Ripple USD
records.summary: RLUSD launched across Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Retail, with 1:1 conversion from USD and supported USD stablecoins. Deposits/withdrawals supported across XRPL, Base and Ethereum. Ripple says it will provide Base liquidity. RLUSD collateral for Coinbase Global Exchange customers is a future follow-on, not current availability.
records.limitations: Does not disclose net RLUSD subscriptions, XRP purchases or live Global Exchange collateral balances.

records.title: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet, an Economic Operating System for the Internet
records.summary: Circle announced Arc mainnet with USDC as native gas, more than $74B USDC in circulation at launch, SBI Group in the founding validator cohort, Coinbase as exchange-access partner and Morpho as a credit-layer participant.
records.limitations: Company launch claims; Arc is a separate L1 and XRP is not its native gas asset.

records.title: Now Available: USDC on the XRPL
records.summary: Circle announced native USDC on XRPL mainnet and support through Circle Mint and Circle APIs.
records.limitations: USDC on XRPL is an issued stablecoin, not XRP investment.

records.title: Ripple and Circle Launch USDC on the XRP Ledger
records.summary: Ripple and Circle jointly announced native USDC on XRPL. Ripple said its payments solution would use USDC alongside RLUSD. This establishes direct cooperation while the firms also compete in stablecoin issuance.
records.limitations: Does not quantify current payment volume or XRP market demand.

records.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission — Circle Form 10-Q
records.title: Circle Internet Group Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
records.summary: Circle reported $324.6M distribution costs to Coinbase in Q2 2026 and $655.3M for H1 2026. The filing describes Coinbase allocations based on USDC held on its platform and broader ecosystem growth under the collaboration agreement.
records.methodology: SEC filing, distribution-cost and collaboration-agreement disclosures.
records.limitations: Distribution expenses are not XRP purchases or direct capital flows into XRPL.

records.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission — Coinbase Form 10-Q
records.title: Coinbase Global Q3 2026 Form 10-Q
records.summary: Coinbase states 2026 priorities are Everything Exchange, stablecoins/payments and onchain adoption. Q3 net revenue was $1.160B, transaction revenue $590.2M, subscription/services $570.2M, stablecoin revenue $306.905M and net income $718.7M. Coinbase says average USDC held in products reached an all-time high and its Circle arrangement was renewed on the same terms.
records.methodology: SEC filing, executive overview and financial tables.
records.limitations: Q3 ended September 30, before the October 28 RLUSD launch; Q3 financials cannot measure its impact.

records.title: XRP spot ETF flows
records.summary: Provider reports approximately +$8.4M net XRP spot ETF flows for October 29 across five-fund coverage.
records.limitations: Coverage differs from other aggregators; flow is not automatically net unhedged spot buying.

records.title: XRP Exchange Balances
records.summary: Provider reports 22.37B XRP in 701 labelled wallets across 24 exchanges, about 32.6% of circulating supply, and a same-wallet-set seven-day change of -234.9M XRP. Tracked set includes cold storage and is not tradable order-book float.
records.limitations: Wallet labels are provider attributions; customer custody and cold storage are included.

records.title: Transaction Cost
records.summary: XRPL documentation states current minimum standard transaction cost is 10 drops (0.00001 XRP), destroyed rather than paid to a party, and may rise under network load.
records.limitations: Minimum is dynamic under load; this is not a measurement of current stablecoin-related fee burn.

records.title: Cross Analysis scheduled writer execution and push log
records.summary: Run 41182259549 executed Cross Analysis on schedule. Job 124481893592 completed successfully; logs show staging, commit and push to main. XRP and BTC windows had zero entries and null scores.
records.methodology: GitHub Actions run metadata and job log.
records.limitations: This proves the workflow path for this commit, not that the generated sentiment was a valid signal.

records.title: Unsigned timestamp-only Cross-analysis refresh main commit
records.summary: Main commit b90e600 is unsigned and changes only generated_at in sentiment_shift.json, from 06:51:46.428498Z to 07:51:51.374133Z. XRP/BTC entry counts remain zero and scores null. Pages deployment run 41182269255 succeeded afterward.
records.methodology: Commit metadata, patch and parent/current file comparison.
records.limitations: Successful Pages deployment does not make zero-sample sentiment a valid signal.

records.title: Complete open pull-request inventory after PR #1401 creation
records.summary: Two-page REST inventory returned 175 open PRs: 165 drafts, 10 ready, 173 main-based, two non-main; one main-based PR (#1401) targets current main b90e600 and 172 main-based PRs have stale base SHAs.
records.methodology: GitHub REST pulls pages 1 and 2; exact base SHA compared with main ref.
records.limitations: Stale does not prove conflict; no bulk rebase or merge was performed.

records.title: PR #1401 read-only Cross Analysis CI and fail-closed gate
records.summary: Fresh-main PR #1401 exact-head CI passed 345 tests and 8 subtests, including three new workflow-safety tests. Fail-closed gate 41183168176 passed with merging disabled. PR remains open, draft, unmerged and mergeable.
records.methodology: GitHub Actions run/job logs and PR metadata.
records.limitations: Artifact-only workflow does not automatically update tracked web JSON or GitHub Pages; a separate reviewed Pages deployment is required to preserve public-site refresh.

records.title: PR #1400 fixed-horizon forecast ledger proposal
records.summary: PR #1400 remains open, draft and unmerged, with base b28f43c stale relative to current main b90e600. Prior exact-head CI passed 366 tests plus 8 subtests and its fail-closed gate passed. It provides a forecast/outcome ledger, not a trained or calibrated prediction model.
records.methodology: PR metadata and exact-head CI/gate evidence.
records.limitations: No walk-forward training, calibration, drift detection, shadow execution or concurrent-writer locking verified.
